svg.aria-label: The GIF to video conversion pipeline: detect an opaque animated GIF, decode frames with ImageDecoder, encode with the WebCodecs VideoEncoder and mediabunny, store the video and poster as companion files, and offer a block switch in the editor.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A separate WebCodecs pipeline — no libvips involved. Falls back transparently when VideoEncoder is unavailable.
isAnimatedGif() confirms the GIF is animated and opaque — transparent GIFs stay images, since <video>
The browser's ImageDecoder unpacks every frame, honoring real per-frame delays.
WebCodecs VideoEncoder + mediabunny produce H.264/MP4 or VP9/WebM in a Web Worker
Video + first-frame poster are sideloaded onto the original GIF attachment
(media_details.animated_video) — the GIF remains a single image/gif attachment.
"Display as video" on a standalone Image block switches it to the Video block's "GIF" variation
(autoplay loop muted playsinline). Reversible via "Display as GIF"; Gallery images are untouched.
